### Love Earnestly
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/love-earnestly
Passage: 1 Peter 1:22
Points:
- Genuine saving faith inevitably produces obedience expressed through sincere brotherly love.
- Loving fellow Christians is both a fruit of spiritual obedience and a direct command.
- The motivation and power to love stem from regeneration by God's enduring Word.
- Pursuing personal holiness is incomplete if believers fail to love one another deeply.

### The Living and Active Word of God
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B170517/the-living-and-active-word-of-god
Passage: 1 Peter 1:24-25
Points:
- In contrast to mortal human life that decays like grass, God's Word endures forever.
- Scripture is perennially fresh and never grows obsolete or outdated across generations.
- The Word functions as an imperishable seed that brings about new spiritual birth.
- When received into a receptive heart, the Spirit uses the Word to produce ongoing growth and life.
